newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CSOB grants CZK 500mln loan to SPT - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech CSOB grants CZK 500mln loan to SPT - CTK.

text.p: Czech Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. said on Thursday it granted a 500 million crown loan to the country's monopoly fixed-line phone operator SPT Telecom a.s, the CTK news agency reported.
CTK did not give any details on the terms of the credit, and officials at SPT and CSOB were not immediately available for comment.
CTK quoted CSOB spokesman Milan Tomanek as saying that the loan was "an important signal in the current tense situation on the crown market".
Interest rates in the Czech Republic skyrocketed when the central bank defended the crown against speculative attacks prior to and after floating the currency on May 27.
The six month Prague interbank offered rate stood at 25 percent on Thursday afternoon, while overnight money was quoted at 48.5 percent.
